Email Subject Line Generator

Write irresistible email subject lines — enter a topic, pick a tone, and get 10 lines using curiosity, urgency, and social-proof hooks.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your email topic.
  2. Pick a tone.
  3. Press Generate, then click any line to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What tones are available?

Curious, urgent, friendly, professional, and funny — each tone uses its own psychological hook templates.

What psychological hooks are used?

Curiosity gaps, numbers, questions, urgency, social proof, personalization, and humor.

How do I copy a subject line?

Click any subject line or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
